Name: A different outfit for Shane
Author: AnticAssassin
Description:
[b]Hello fellow Stardew Valley fans,[/b]

this is just a small mod to replace Shane's outfit in the game.

I never really liked that he was wearing a Joja jacket although he hates working there. Also he deserves a nice jacket that isn't as shaggy as his normal one. So I changed his jacket to be dark green. Also I replaced the green polo shirt he's usually wearing with a normal grey one.

How to install:

1) Download and extract the file.
2) Make sure to have a backup of the files in your content folder
3) Put the [b]Shane.xnb[/b] file in the your [b].../Stardew Valley/Content/Characters[/b] folder and overwrite the original file.
4) Now [b]rename the file Shane_portrait.xnb[/b] file to [b]Shane.xnb [/b]and put it in your [b].../Content/Portraits[/b] folder, overwriting the existing file.
5) Start the game and enjoy Shane's new look :)


Take a look at my other mod: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1339/?]Dark red farmhouse with flower pots[/url]
